Fact.Name: Form 8824 exchange reporting destination options
Fact.Description: The six reporting destinations a gain or loss from this form can take: section1231 = property used in your trade or business (or held for the production of rents) held more than 1 year; ordinaryNoncapital = trade or business property held 1 year or less, or other property that is not a capital asset; capitalShortTerm / capitalLongTerm = a capital asset (investment property) held 1 year or less / more than 1 year; personalUseShortTerm / personalUseLongTerm = property held for personal use, such as your home, held 1 year or less / more than 1 year.

Fact.Name: Where this like-kind exchange reports its Form 8824 line 22 gain
Fact.Description: SCREEN. Question: "What kind of property did you give up in this exchange, and how long did you hold it?" Options: section1231 = property used in your trade or business (or held for the production of rents) held more than 1 year; ordinaryNoncapital = trade or business property held 1 year or less, or other property that is not a capital asset; capitalShortTerm / capitalLongTerm = a capital asset (investment property) held 1 year or less / more than 1 year; personalUseShortTerm / personalUseLongTerm = property held for personal use, such as your home, held 1 year or less / more than 1 year. Help text: the Form 8824 instructions report a gain from exchanging property used in a trade or business (and other noncapital assets) on Form 4797 line 5 or line 16, and a gain from exchanging capital assets on Schedule D. ASKED WHEN: this exchange files Form 8824, the installment method does not apply (../writableInstallmentMethodApplies not Yes), and line 22 is above $0. UNANSWERED POSTURE: a positive line 22 with no answer leaves the lines it could feed Incomplete; the return waits. VALIDATION: one of the six options. WHAT IT FEEDS: form4797 Form 4797 line 5 (section1231) or line 16 (ordinaryNoncapital); scheduleD line 4 or line 11 (capital and personal-use options).

Fact.Name: Where this like-kind exchange reports its Form 8824 line 14 gain or loss on other property given up
Fact.Description: SCREEN. Question: "You also gave up other (not like-kind) property in this exchange. What kind of property was it, and how long did you hold it?" Options: section1231 = property used in your trade or business (or held for the production of rents) held more than 1 year; ordinaryNoncapital = trade or business property held 1 year or less, or other property that is not a capital asset; capitalShortTerm / capitalLongTerm = a capital asset (investment property) held 1 year or less / more than 1 year; personalUseShortTerm / personalUseLongTerm = property held for personal use, such as your home, held 1 year or less / more than 1 year. Help text: the gain or loss on other property given up (Form 8824 line 14) is reported as if that property had been sold: Form 4797 line 5 or line 16 for trade or business property, Schedule D for a capital asset. A loss on personal-use property is not deductible. ASKED WHEN: this exchange files Form 8824 and line 14 is not $0. UNANSWERED POSTURE: a nonzero line 14 with no answer leaves the lines it could feed Incomplete; the return waits. VALIDATION: one of the six options. WHAT IT FEEDS: Form 4797 line 5 (section1231) or line 16 (ordinaryNoncapital); Schedule D line 4 or line 11 (capital options; the personal-use options carry a gain and put a loss nowhere).

Fact.Name: The installment method applies to this like-kind exchange (its gain is reported on Form 6252)
Fact.Description: SCREEN. Question: "Did you receive a note or other payment later than this year for this exchange, so that you report its gain on the installment method (Form 6252)?" Help text: when the installment method applies, the Form 8824 instructions send the installment sale income to Form 6252, and the line 21 recapture to Form 6252 line 25 and Form 4797 line 15; so the line 21 and line 22 amounts are reported through that Form 6252 and not again from Form 8824. ASKED WHEN: this exchange files Form 8824 and the return also files a Form 6252. UNANSWERED POSTURE: on a return that files no Form 6252 it reads as No; on a return that files a Form 6252, a positive line 21 or line 22 with no answer leaves the Form 4797 and Schedule D lines Incomplete, because the same gain could otherwise be counted twice. VALIDATION: Boolean, Yes / No. WHAT IT FEEDS: form4797 and scheduleD read it; Yes puts this exchange's line 21 and line 22 on no line (line 14 is not affected).
